items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Do you ever bunk Johnson? Sure, man. You had no bunk. Been no bunk for him. Before he died.

ctx.x: Well, they had a dance band, or no? Brass band. Eagle Brass. Oh, they had a brass band. Eagle Brass Band. And Cornish was in there. Who? You say Cornish was in there. Cornish was a trombone player, yeah. Mm-hmm. Did he play slide or valve trombone?

He played, uh, valve first. Then they all went to getting slides, you know. Mm-hmm. Do you ever bunk Johnson? Sure, man. You had no bunk. Been no bunk for him. Before he died. Oh, he was a good little
trumpet player. What kind of fellow was he?
